newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sumitomo Trust says to buy back eurodollar CBs.
newsitem.headline: Sumitomo Trust says to buy back eurodollar CBs.

text.p: Sumitomo Trust & Banking Co Ltd said on Friday that it had decided to buy back its eurodollar convertible bonds maturing on March 31, 2002, between February 10 and March 10.
It said the planned cash purchase was designed to trim its outstanding debts and strengthen its financial base, while trying to avoid a potential increase in the number of its shares.

As of the end of January, the bank said there was $79.02 million worth of the convertible bonds outstanding, which carry a coupon rate of 1.75 percent. The conversion price of the bond is 3,771.70 yen, the bank said in a statement.
